info.name: Files Compress
info.summary: Compress files and folders to a zip, and extract archives in place
info.description: Adds "Compress" and "Extract here" actions to the Files app. Compression creates a zip alongside the selected file(s) or folder(s); extraction unpacks zip, tar, tar.gz/tgz, tar.bz2, gz and bz2 archives into the current folder. Archive operations run through the system zip/unzip/tar/gzip tools and write straight to their destination — no intermediate temp files — which keeps memory and disk use low for large research datasets and avoids the PHP ZipArchive compatibility quirks.
info.author: Frederik Orellana, DTU
